classification.difficultyReason: Convert the mixed gram and kilogram masses to a common unit, order them and select the third mass.

inlines.text: The masses of five parcels are shown.

spec.description: A relatively broad, tall parcel with a shallow visible top face and sealing tape rests on a scale labelled 320 g.
spec.mathematics: The given mass is 320 g. Illustration dimensions do not encode mass.

inlines.text: . Convert to grams, order, then select the third mass.

answer.worked:
Use $1\,\mathrm{kg}=1000\,\mathrm{g}$, so $2\,\mathrm{kg}=2000\,\mathrm{g}$ and $5\,\mathrm{kg}=5000\,\mathrm{g}$.
Ordered masses in grams: $320,\ 400,\ \underline{1800},\ 2000,\ 5000$.
The third mass is the middle value.
$$\begin{align*}\mathrm{Median}&=1800\,\mathrm{g}\\\mathrm{Median}&=1.8\,\mathrm{kg}\end{align*}$$
